operators.name: relu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input shape [16, 3, 2048, 2048]
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous or non-contiguous as produced by earlier ops)

semantics: Computes elementwise max(x, 0) for each element of the input tensor.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride.

operators.name: softplus_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input shape [16, 3, 2048, 2048]
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous or non-contiguous as produced by earlier ops)

semantics: Computes elementwise softplus: log(1 + exp(x)) with numerical stability for large x.
Equivalent to F.softplus(x) with default beta=1, threshold=20.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride.
Elementwise ReLU activation on tensor x.
Elementwise softplus activation on tensor x (result of step_001).
Returns the tensor from step_002 unchanged.
